newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia cuts trade deficit in January-October.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia cuts trade deficit in January-October.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit in the first ten months of 1996 fell to 1.74 billion dinars from 1.89 billion in the same 1995 period, official figures showed on Tuesday.
Exports rose 3.1 percent to 4.366 billion dinars from 4,235 billion, while imports fell to 6.105 billion dinars from 6.125 billion, down 0.3 percent.

The figures, released by the National Institute of Statistics, showed that phosphate exports rose 18.1 percent, energy exports 11.8 percent, and textiles, Tunisia's main manufacturing sector exporter, by 7.8 percent. ($=0.98 dinar)
